dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: The wine here's pretty good! Boss, two more glasses of Dandelion Wine, please!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Come on, drink with me! I ordered a whole bunch already — cold ones, room temperature ones... Just take your pick!

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Ha, looks like we have a winner — me! Well that was a breeze... Do I play often? Mmm... Just now and then. I have a lot of important responsibilities, y'know. You don't actually think I have that much time on my hands, do you!?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: *sigh* All that baloney about "destined draws," "the duelist's will," and "having a connection with your deck"... In reality, if you get a poor hand, you get a poor hand.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: A game of cards? Sure thing! I'm always— Ahem, well, I've been known to dabble on occasion. And I've read King of Invokations cover to cover multiple times.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Someone's looking a bit rusty... Oh? That wasn't your usual level? Hmph, let's start over then — but this time, no excuses.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: L—Like I said, I've only dabbled a little. It's not like I've practiced that much or anything...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Hah, challenge accepted. Careful though, or you'll be begging for mercy before you know it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: And, what did I tell you? That's exactly what happens when you don't listen to your elders... Hey, it's not like I'm going out of my way to pick on you! C'mon, let's play another round.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Ahem... I decided to let you win a few rounds first. C'mon, let's play again — this time, it's for real.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
